mapper.select: SELECT CASE a.attend_type WHEN 1 THEN '出勤' WHEN 2 THEN '迟到' WHEN 3 THEN '早退' WHEN 4 THEN '缺勤' WHEN 5 THEN '请假' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM att_attendance a WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY name ORDER BY MIN(a.attend_type) ASC

SELECT s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attend_type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absentCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attend_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lateCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attend_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earlyCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attend_type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS leaveCount, COUNT(a.id) AS totalCount FROM stu_student s LEFT JOIN att_attendance a ON a.student_id = s.id WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.student_no ORDER BY absentCount DESC, lateCount DESC
